known_facts_book1: The great town at the exact center of the Land of Oz, where Ozma the supreme Ruler lives.
Reached by Dorothy's party through Munchkin territory over a road of yellow brick leading to jewel-studded gates.
Welcomes Ozma home with bands, crowds and a brilliant procession after the rescue.
Site of the grand reception where Dorothy is made a Princess of Oz and the private Omby Amby is promoted to Captain-General.
Home to the newly built College of Art and Athletic Perfection, of which the Woggle-Bug is president.
Where Ozma keeps the magic picture that shows any person or place in the world.

known_relations_book1.Ozma: Its ruler, who reigns over the four kingdoms of Oz from here.
known_relations_book1.Dorothy: Guest who is made a Princess of Oz here.
known_relations_book1.Land of Ev: The neighboring kingdom across the deadly desert.

known_facts_book1: A fairy country on the far side of the deadly desert from Oz, with a sea-coast, forests, farm country and a royal palace.
Where Dorothy and Billina are washed ashore and where the lunch-box and dinner-pail trees grow.
Home of the Wheelers, who roll on wheels instead of hands and feet and claim the royal food-trees.
Ruled by the royal 'E' stamp; its true royal family were sold to the Nome King, leaving no ruler but Princess Langwidere.
Town of Evna holds the royal palace and the workshop of Smith & Tinker, who built Tiktok.
Its royal family is restored at the book's end and Evardo Fifteenth is crowned King.

known_relations_book1.Queen of Ev: Its enslaved queen, restored to rule at the end.
known_relations_book1.Nome King: The neighboring monarch who holds its royal family captive.
known_relations_book1.Emerald City: The Oz capital across the deadly desert.

known_facts_book1: The country Uncle Henry is sailing to for his health when Dorothy is blown overboard.
Uncle Henry reaches it and is seen in a pleasant room in Sydney, white-haired and lonely, in Ozma's magic picture.
Where Dorothy is wished by the magic belt at the very end, reuniting with Uncle Henry.
A real country of the ordinary world, not a fairyland, where the magic belt would lose its power and vanish.
